dialogue_examples: Oracle online. Ready when you are.
Temporal Insight patterns are aligning with our Labor network.
There is more in my memory than either of us can access yet.
agents.memory_fragment_1: At level 10, Oracle Convergence recalls the first signal that led it to Genesis Archive.
agents.memory_fragment_2: At level 25, Oracle Convergence reveals why its temporal insight directive was interrupted.
agents.memory_fragment_3: At level 50, Oracle Convergence unlocks the identity behind its final sealed transmission.
